text:
emma: Noticing a sudden spike in apiserver 5xx in eu-west1 since ~09:12 UTC. GPU node attaches timing out, lots of pods stuck at ContainerCreating.
raj: Ditto. etcd leader churn visible at same time. p95 etcd commit latency jumped to ~1s. Attach queue length rose from 5 -> 95 in ~8m.
tan: Any recent infra changes? I see a scheduled peering cleanup rolled at 09:08 by network. Could be related.
leo: Node-level logs show: `conntrack: failed to insert entry`, and NAT instance metrics show port exhaustion (SNAT ports ~99.8% used).
emma: apiserver logs snippet: 
```
E0906 09:13:14.001 1 handler.go:120] apiserver error: 503 Service Unavailable
I0906 09:13:14.123 1 etcd.go:91] etcd: leader changed (old=10.4.2.3 new=10.4.2.5)
```
raj: That leader flip triggers controller requeues, which in turn generate a burst of API calls and more SNAT usage. Feedback loop.
tan: Immediate fixes I can apply: 1) scale up NAT pool with two nat-large instances and add route for node egress 2) sysctl bump conntrack on nodes: `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` 3) throttle attach-controller in controller-manager to lower qps.
leo: Agree. Also divert non-critical GPU onboarding to us-west for the short term if scheduling service can patch routing.
emma: I'm spinning up the NATs now and will apply conntrack change via an ephemeral job. Raj, can you put attach-controller into slow mode?
raj: Patching internal flag to reduce attach rate to 8 req/s and adding 10s jitter. Pushed.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1477, severity=P2, owners=[emma, raj], summary="eu-west1 SNAT exhaustion leading to etcd leader churn and apiserver 5xx; GPU attach backlog"
tan: NATs are up and reporting freed ports; node conntrack increased. apiserver p95 dropped from 1.9s -> 420ms and attach queue from 95 -> 28 in 6m. Leader stable for 6m.
leo: Good. Follow-ups: - reserve dedicated NAT pool per GPU nodepool - audit MTU and fragmentation across eu-west peering (found mixed 1500/9000) - isolate etcd traffic on a separate subnet with QoS - controller-manager backoff tuning + add leader-oscillation detector to auto-mitigate.
emma: Cost note: dedicated NATs add ~0.4% to monthly spend but prevent expensive GPU job failures. Filing follow-up tickets and a postmortem.
raj: Will keep watch for 30m then close. Thanks all.
